svg.title: Sample home — 3 BHK apartment floor plan
svg.desc: An illustrative architectural floor plan used by the Prem Marg VASTU studio: main entrance on the east wall opening into a foyer, pooja in the north-east, living room with a north balcony, dining at the centre, kitchen in the south-east, staircase on the south, master bedroom with attached toilet in the south-west, two further bedrooms on the west and north-west, and a common toilet beside the foyer. North points up.
svg.text: Illustrative plan for the Prem Marg VASTU studio · not to scale · not a real property
